title: Profile
description: ARCH-01 genre-profile contract. A declarative JSON config of constants + a small fixed set of OPTIONAL override hooks (designed, exercised only when a real genre-specific constraint emerges — D-13). Used by the daemon profile loader (Plan 03). Source: CONTEXT.md D-13/D-14 + RESEARCH.md §Code Examples 'profile JSON shape'.
$comment: ARCH-01/02 contract. Source-of-truth decisions: D-13 (profile = data + optional hooks — electronic/techno v1 ships JSON-only so the hook contract is exercised only when a real need emerges), D-14 (generic default, techno opted-in — the daemon ships a STRICT generic core with hardcoded neutral defaults; electronic/techno is a SEPARATE profile the producer OPTS INTO via intent.json). Profile-absent → generic core runs LITERALLY (INV-13).

name.description: Profile identifier. 'generic' is the strict neutral default (D-14); 'techno' is the first opt-in profile.

extends.description: Optional parent profile name. The loader deep-merges over the parent (thresholds/curves/scales/roleSalience). 'techno' extends 'generic'.

thresholds.description: Motif-similarity thresholds per transform type. Creative transforms (vary/counterline) refuse below threshold (D-08); cleanup transforms (voiceLeadingFix/humanize) skip the motif gate (D-10 → 0.0).

velocityHumanize.description: MIDI-05 velocity humanize parameters. jitter = ±N velocity (gaussian); curve shapes the distribution.

timingHumanize.description: MIDI-05 timing humanize parameters. jitterBeats = ±N beats (gaussian).

roleSalience.description: Track role → motif-salience weight. 'kick', 'bass', 'lead', 'pad', 'hats', 'percussion', 'fx' are the conventional keys; the open map allows profile-specific extensions.

preferredScales.description: Scale/mode names preferred for the inferred-harmony fallback (D-12). tonal Scale.get() consumes these. Generic prefers [minor, dorian, phrygian]; techno prefers [minor, phrygian, locrian].

strongBeatGrid.description: Beat positions within a 4/4 bar that count as 'strong' (counterline target, vary anchor). Generic: [0,1,2,3] (every beat); techno: [0,2] (4-on-the-floor).
